scope: Existing capability domain, extended with external data consumption
required_controls: timeouts and retry budget with jitter and Retry-After
reference period distinct from retrieval time
freshness quality SLOs and observable failures
maturity_limits: Local single JSON-resource reference, no distributed guarantees

Custom lineage manifest is not certified OpenLineage

interfaces.consumer: source configuration, authorized data, frequency and semantics
